zh.name: 万象归墟
zh.description: 卡俄斯在战场中心召唤“奇点”，每<color=#02ff00>5</color>秒对范围内敌人造成<color=#02ff00>600%</color>攻击力的伤害，如果释放时已经有“奇点”时“奇点”范围扩大并立即造成一次伤害，“奇点”最多扩大<color=#02ff00>3</color>次，之后每次释放不再扩大范围转而增加“奇点”<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力的伤害（最多增加<color=#02ff00>10</color>次）

upgrades.zh: 等级2：每5秒对范围内敌人造成<color=#02ff00>650%</color>攻击力的伤害
upgrades.en: Deals 650% ATK as DMG to enemies within the AoE every 5 seconds.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：范围达到最大时，之后每次释放不再扩大范围转而增加“奇点”<color=#02ff00>300%</color>攻击力的伤害
upgrades.en: When the AoE reaches its maximum, subsequent casts will no longer expand the AoE, but will instead increase the "Singularity" DMG by 300% ATK.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：每5秒对范围内敌人造成<color=#02ff00>700%</color>攻击力的伤害
upgrades.en: Deals 700% ATK as DMG to enemies within the AoE every 5 seconds.

en.name: Universal Ruin
en.description: Khaos summons a "Singularity" in the center of the battlefield, dealing 600% ATK as DMG to enemies within the AoE every 5 seconds. If a "Singularity" already exists when cast, its AoE expands and immediately deals DMG once. The "Singularity" can expand up to 3 times. Subsequent casts will no longer expand the AoE, but will instead increase the "Singularity" DMG by 200% ATK (up to 10 times).

zh.name: 维度坠临
zh.description: 战斗开始时，给距离自身最近的友方前排单位恢复<color=#02ff00>200</color>点能量并将其传送至敌方战场中心，落地时对周围敌人造成<color=#02ff00>500%</color>攻击力的伤害

upgrades.zh: 等级2：落地时对周围敌人造成<color=#02ff00>550%</color>攻击力的伤害
upgrades.en: Upon landing, deals 550% ATK as DMG to surrounding enemies.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：落地时对周围敌人造成<color=#02ff00>600%</color>攻击力的伤害
upgrades.en: Upon landing, deals 600% ATK as DMG to surrounding enemies.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：落地时对周围敌人造成<color=#02ff00>650%</color>攻击力的伤害
upgrades.en: Upon landing, deals 650% ATK as DMG to surrounding enemies.

en.name: Dimensional Descent
en.description: At the start of battle, restores 200 Energy to the nearest allied front-row unit and teleports them to the center of the enemy battlefield. Upon landing, deals 500% ATK as DMG to surrounding enemies.

zh.name: 虚空放逐
zh.description: 被动的，当敌方神明单位生命值降低至<color=#02ff00>10%</color>时，卡俄斯紊乱其周围的空间，<color=#02ff00>2</color>秒后若目标仍然存活则将其放逐，一场战斗只能触发一次，若目标在持续期间死亡则不消耗放逐次数（放逐：被放逐的单位直接被移出战场，无法触发阵亡或击杀反应，无法被复活）

upgrades.zh: 等级2：放逐阈值提升至<color=#02ff00>14%</color>生命值
upgrades.en: Banishment threshold increases to 14% of HP.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：放逐阈值提升至<color=#02ff00>18%</color>生命值
upgrades.en: Banishment threshold increases to 18% of HP.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：放逐阈值提升至<color=#02ff00>22%</color>生命值
upgrades.en: Banishment threshold increases to 22% of HP.

en.name: Void Banishment
en.description: Passive: When an enemy Deity unit's HP drops to 10%, Khaos disrupts the space around them. If the target is still alive after 2 sec, they are banished. This can only be triggered once per battle. If the target dies during the duration, the banishment count is not consumed. (Banish: Banished units are directly removed from the battlefield, cannot trigger Fall or kill reactions, and cannot be revived.)

zh.name: 虚界回返
zh.description: 被动的，卡俄斯受到致命伤害时，自身进入异界<color=#02ff00>5</color>秒，不再被攻击，卡俄斯位于异界时自身每秒恢复<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力的生命值，从异界返回时，对周围敌人造成<color=#02ff00>300%</color>攻击力的伤害和击退效果

upgrades.zh: 等级2：卡俄斯位于异界时自身每秒回复自身攻击力<color=#02ff00>250%</color>生命
upgrades.en: Restores HP equal to 250% of ATK per sec while Khaos is in the Rift.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：从异界返回时，卡俄斯对周围单位造成<color=#02ff00>400%</color>攻击力的伤害和击退效果
upgrades.en: When returning from the Rift, Khaos deals DMG equal to 400% of ATK and Knocks back surrounding units.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：卡俄斯位于异界时自身每秒回复自身攻击力<color=#02ff00>300%</color>生命
upgrades.en: Restores HP equal to 300% of ATK per sec while Khaos is in the Rift.

en.name: Return from the Void
en.description: Passive: When Khaos takes Lethal DMG, she enters The Rift for 5 seconds and can no longer be attacked. While in The Rift, Khaos Restores HP equal to 200% ATK per second. Upon returning from The Rift, she deals 300% ATK as DMG and applies a knockback effect to surrounding enemies.

levels.zh: 【虚空放逐】不再有次数限制，每次触发间隔<color=#02ff00>50</color>秒
levels.en: [Void Banishment] no longer has a usage limit, with a trigger interval of 50 sec.

levels.zh: 当有敌方神明被放逐时，触发一次【万象归墟】效果
levels.en: When an enemy Deity is banished, triggers the effect of [Universal Ruin] once.

levels.zh: 【虚空放逐】不再有次数限制，每次触发间隔降低至<color=#02ff00>25</color>秒
levels.en: [Void Banishment] no longer has a usage limit, and the trigger interval is reduced to 25 sec.

levels.zh: 战斗开始时，立即触发一次【万象归墟】效果
levels.en: At the start of the battle, immediately triggers the effect of [Universal Ruin] once.
